author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be Discord doubling down on it's plan to push digital ID to the entire world. Discord seems to be partnering with people that have been linked to mass surveillance entities and while the intentions seem noble this is the slippery slope into tracking every activity we do online. Thanks for watching!

title: Discord Made A Terrible Response...
